name: GATA binding protein 2

function.text: GATA2 encodes a zinc-finger transcription factor important for hematopoietic stem and progenitor-cell maintenance and development of several blood-cell lineages.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to GATA2 deficiency with susceptibility to MDS/AML (autosomal dominant); deafness-lymphedema-leukemia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Acute Myeloid Leukemia. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
